headline: Job position changes in the EPD and Water Works, plus a motion to enter non-public session on pending claims or litigation.
summary: Robert Robinson, EPD Chief Engineer, asks to eliminate one position and add three in the division. Phil Croasdale, Water Works Director, asks to replace an Accountant I position with an Accountant II.
items: EPD position changes: eliminate one Environmental Permit Program Manager; add three engineering and technician positions
Water Works position change: replace one Accountant I with one Accountant II
Motion to enter non-public session on pending claims or litigation (RSA 91-A:3(II)(e))
item_action_words: A roll call vote is required on the motion.
plain_text:
COMMITTEE ON HUMAN RESOURCES/INSURANCE 
December 1, 2026 at 6:15 PM 
Aldermanic Chambers, City Hall (3rd Floor) 
 
Members: Aldermen Goonan, Sapienza, O'Neil, Burkush, Vincent 
 
AGENDA 
 
 
The Chairman calls the meeting to order. 
  
The Clerk calls the roll. 
  
1. Communication from Robert Robinson, EPD Chief Engineer, requesting the 
following changes to the division's complement: 
• Eliminate one (1) Environmental Permit Program Manager position, 
grade 119; 
• Add one (1) Civil Engineer III position, grade 121; 
• Add one (1) Project Manager - Engineering position, grade 124; 
• Add one (1) Engineer Technician III position, grade 117. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
2. Communication from Phil Croasdale, Water Works Director, requesting the 
following changes to the department's complement: 
• Eliminate one (1) Accountant I position, grade 108; 
• Add one (1) Accountant II position, grade 113. 
Gentlemen, what is your pleasure? 
    
3. A motion would be in order to enter non-public session under the 
provisions of RSA 91-A:3(II)(e): Consideration or negotiation of pending 
claims or litigation which has been threatened or claimed against the 
public body or any subdivision thereof. 
  
 A roll call vote is required on the motion. 
    
If there is no further business, a motion is in order to adjourn.
